SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period >= 7
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, COUNT(*) AS versions, MIN(p.valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(p.valid_from) AS max_from
FROM dim_product p
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%light%'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.category_as_was AS category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_product_join', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-27' AS after_move, p.category, p.subcategory, p.valid_from >= DATE '2025-10-27' AS new_version,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting'

    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS my_total
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS control_total
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.my_total, c.control_total, ROUND(m.my_total - c.control_total,2) AS gap
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was, p.subcategory AS sub_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_was = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS garden_as_was,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.category = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS garden_as_is,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_was = 'Garden' AND n.sub_was = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS outdoor_lighting_in_garden_was,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_was <> cp.category AND NOT (n.sub_was='Outdoor Lighting') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_category_changes
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
